title: Satay Sauce
description: Rich, creamy, slightly spicy, and perfect for chicken, beef, lamb, veggies — or eaten straight from the pan when no one's watching.

ingredients.notes: add gradually to thin as needed

method.instruction: Combine peanut butter, soy sauce, curry powder, and coconut milk in a small saucepan.
Warm gently over low heat, stirring patiently until smooth and well combined. Do not let it boil.
Add water a splash at a time until the sauce reaches your desired consistency — thick enough to coat, thin enough to pour.
Taste and adjust: add more curry powder for heat, a splash more soy sauce for depth, or a squeeze of lime for brightness.

notes.title: Curry Powder
notes.content: Add curry powder gradually and taste as you go — you can always add more, but too much will overpower the peanut flavour. Keen's curry powder works well here.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Serve warm over grilled chicken skewers, beef strips, lamb, or roasted vegetables. Also excellent as a dipping sauce for spring rolls or satay skewers.
